describe.description: Describe the twin: model, source files with sha256, thresholds (elevatedPpm, criticalPpm), budget. No arguments.

time_to_critical.description: Simulate the cabin CO2 from a starting state. Arguments (all optional): co2Ppm (number, ppm, default 1500), crew (array of 1 or 2 objects {count: number, activity: one of sleep, rest, light_work, heavy_work}; default 4 asleep), flowPercent (number 0-100, default 33), stopMinutes (number, default 0), resumePercent (number 0-100, default 100), horizonMinutes (number, default 240, maximum 1440). Returns minutesToElevated, minutesToCritical, peakPpm, finalState (one of NOMINAL, ELEVATED, CRITICAL), trajectory.

properties.crew.activity: string, required in each group, one of: sleep, rest, light_work, heavy_work

sweep.description: Operating map. Argument flowPercents: array of 1 to 20 numbers from 0 to 100, required. Optional: co2Ppm (number, default 1500), crew (array of 1 or 2 groups {count, activity}; activity one of sleep, rest, light_work, heavy_work), minutes (number, default 240, maximum 1440). Returns one point per flow: flowPercent, peakPpm, finalState, minutesToElevated, minutesToCritical, steadyStatePpm, scrubberEnergyWh.

properties.flowPercents: array of numbers, required, 1 to 20 values, each 0 to 100
properties.crew.activity: string, required in each group, one of: sleep, rest, light_work, heavy_work
